'''Marku''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Dantooine Incursion]], Marku was stationed in a hidden Imperial base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. She worked on behalf of [[Darth Xarion]] and was tasked with making sure the [[Nova Blades]] were punished and their [[Walker/Legends|walker]] was shut down in the [[Nova Blade Camp]].<ref name="Shinytoy" />
